# KI: Distributed DAG Task Execution with Dynamic Template Value Resolution

## Operational Summary
Chaining complex multi-agent workflows requires passing outputs between independent tasks without hardcoding dependencies in code. Em-Cubed implements an asynchronous `ProcessDistributedExecutor` featuring dot-path template resolution (`{{ tasks.<task_id>.result.<field> }}`) that automatically scans parent results and substitutes parameter values before spawning child worker processes.
